item_name: Rothco Military Force Amphibious Play Set
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Amphibious Play Set offers endless fun and adventure for children aged 3 and up. This engaging set includes 3 action figures, a dog, a sturdy boat, and a spotlight trailer to inspire imaginative play on land and water. Made with durable materials, the set requires no assembly or batteries, making it easy to dive into playtime right out of the box. Whether recreating daring rescue missions or exciting exploration scenarios, this play set encourages creativity and storytelling.
